description: An invoice builder composed from the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5: a money form with currency prefixes, percent suffixes and a masked tax ID through frame adornments, line items with SvNumberInput quantities, SvPopconfirm on delete with an Undo action toast, live SvStat totals, an SvHoverCard hint on the tax rate and a promise toast when the invoice is sent.

faq.question: How are the totals kept live?
faq.answer: Subtotal, tax and total are $derived over the lines array, so editing a quantity or rate in an SvNumberInput updates the SvStat tiles on every keystroke.

faq.question: How does delete with Undo work?
faq.answer: SvPopconfirm confirms the removal, the line is removed from the array and a toast offers Undo, which reinserts the line at its old index.

faq.question: Why a masked input for the tax ID?
faq.answer: The mask '##-#######' enforces the format as the user types and reports the raw digits, so validation is a length check.
